HI Kiff,

Li Cai's original comparisons are probably a good place to start, but honestly the comparison realms are inherently a little different. MHRM is generally for higher dimensional models where the EM starts to become prohibitively complex. I'm also not really sure what you mean by 'qhat'; could you explain? 

Phil
